parameters.query: SELECT $1::jsonb || jsonb_build_object('portal_url', (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'portal_url')) AS r

SELECT json_build_object(
  'domain', lower($1),
  'portal_ok', lower($1) = lower(regexp_replace((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'portal_url'), '^https?://|/.*$', '', 'g')),
  'app', (SELECT row_to_json(x) FROM (SELECT status, installed_at FROM b24_app WHERE domain = lower($1)) x)) AS st

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Parse event').first().json.member_id, $('Parse event').first().json.application_token, $('Parse event').first().json.access_token, $('Parse event').first().json.refresh_token ?? '', $('Parse event').first().json.expires_in, $('Parse event').first().json.client_endpoint ?? ''] }}

parameters.query:
UPDATE b24_app SET application_token = $2, access_token = $3, refresh_token = $4,
       expires_at = now() + make_interval(secs => $5::int), client_endpoint = coalesce(nullif($6, ''), client_endpoint),
       status = 'installed', refresh_lock_until = NULL, updated_at = now()
 WHERE member_id = $1
RETURNING member_id

INSERT INTO b24_app (member_id, domain, client_endpoint, server_endpoint, access_token, refresh_token,
                     expires_at, application_token, scope, status, installed_at, install_report, updated_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, now() + make_interval(secs => $7::int), $8, $9, 'installed', now(), $10::jsonb, now())
ON CONFLICT (member_id) DO UPDATE SET
  domain = EXCLUDED.domain, client_endpoint = EXCLUDED.client_endpoint, server_endpoint = EXCLUDED.server_endpoint,
  access_token = EXCLUDED.access_token, refresh_token = EXCLUDED.refresh_token, expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at,
  application_token = EXCLUDED.application_token, scope = EXCLUDED.scope, status = 'installed',
  installed_at = now(), install_report = EXCLUDED.install_report, refresh_lock_until = NULL, updated_at = now()
RETURNING member_id

SELECT $1::jsonb || jsonb_build_object(
  'valid', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM b24_app WHERE status = 'installed' AND application_token = $2 AND member_id = $3),
  'portal_ok', $4 = lower(regexp_replace((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'portal_url'), '^https?://|/.*$', '', 'g'))
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM b24_app WHERE domain = $4 AND member_id <> $3)) AS ev
